name: wpc-mods-claude
description: carreirodev's mods for Claude Code: install only the ones you want

plugins.name: status-pills
plugins.description: Pill strip by the prompt: model and effort, context, 5-hour and 7-day limits with their resets, project and branch, prompt cache

plugins.name: agents-panel
plugins.description: Side panel with every agent in the session (model, effort, timer and token usage) plus background shells

plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: Enhance and Send buttons above the prompt: rewrites your draft in place, clearer for the AI, without adding anything

plugins.name: plan-progress
plugins.description: Live plan progress bars above the prompt, with soft sounds
